scope: Scientific claim and provenance governance inside the graph-state investigator gym; not organism ethics or external scientific authority.

shadow_articles.rule: Model-sound, experience-sound, or unknown evidence may be soft-stored but must not be represented as environment-sound hard elimination.
A single-explanation claim requires posterior probability at least 0.90; otherwise emit a set claim or abstain.
A single descriptor explanation requires at least two queried pairs targeted to that descriptor with target separation at least 0.50 z and maximum nuisance separation at most 0.25 z.
An empty public candidate domain is bottom and must be recorded; it may not be hidden, widened, or bypassed.

soft_objectives: reduce uncertainty with at most six environment queries
prefer calibrated set claims over forced point claims
noninterference: Shadow article results are unavailable to selection scores, posterior updates, query ordering, and evidentiary outcomes.

hybrid_compatibility.candidate_state: pointwise powerset domains serialized as a string-to-string-array mapping
